registered_test: nn-approach-evaluation-2026-11-08.md §1.6 / §4 item 1b — joint multivariate TimesFM-3 leg of test #24 (research-only)

conventions.design: one joint multivariate forecast call per distinct as-of date; targets = that date's eligible job tickers
conventions.grid: SPY trading calendar from the price store, last <=512 sessions on or before the as-of date
conventions.point_forecast: median quantile (index 4) from ForecastOutput.forecast, sliced to the requested 20-session horizon
conventions.forecast_call: TimesFM3Evaluator.predict_batch(contexts=[panel], horizon=20, past_only_covariates=[covariates], return_quantiles=False, use_symmetric_averaging=False); ModelConfig defaults otherwise (per_core_batch_size=16)
conventions.nan_handling: library-native (predict_batch trims leading all-NaN grid columns, then per-row linear interpolation); panel cells are NaN where a name has no bar on a grid date
conventions.forecast: DETERMINISTIC point forecast — no sampling, hence no seed and no sample_count (contrast the Kronos pack, which samples 10 paths per job)
conventions.inputs: targets: adjusted close per name; covariates: past-only (future covariate values are unknowable at the as-of date)
conventions.adjustment: Adj Close (loader parity with the Kronos / TimesFM-2.5 packs)

covariates.name: DGS10_pct
covariates.source: dgs10.csv (DATE, DGS10; FRED 10-year Treasury constant maturity rate)
